# Synthetic phrase-pilot sample

## Intake

When the support agent opens the case board, the system lists every open ticket.
The support agent clicks the Create Ticket button.
The system creates a new support ticket under the same customer account.

## Review

The manager selects a ticket from the review queue.
The manager drags the ticket onto the Escalation Lane.
The system moves the ticket and keeps the audit trail.
When the manager finishes the draft, the system releases a minor version.
